style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><p style="margin-left:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:0.5in;text-align:center;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">THIS EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT (this &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Agreement</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) is entered into by and between Cerenome, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Company</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;), and Ronald A. Andrews (&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Executive</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;), and shall be effective as of November 9, 2026 (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Effective Date</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;).</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">WHEREAS, the Company desires to employ Executive, and Executive desires to be employed by the Company, on the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual promises herein contained, the parties agree to the following:</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:32px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;min-width:0.5in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:2.813%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">1.</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Definitions</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  As used in this Agreement, the following terms shall have the following meanings:</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:13pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	(a)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Acquisition Agreement Date</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the first day on which the Company and the acquirer formally or informally agree on the terms of a transaction which, if consummated, would constitute a Change in Control. Informal agreement need not be legally binding, and can be evidenced by such things as a letter of intent (even if legally non-binding) or taking steps, in reliance on the existence of an informal agreement, in contemplation of the consummation of the Change in Control.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(b)	&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Board</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Board of Directors of the Company.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(c)	&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Cause</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means any of the following:</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(i) 	Executive&#x2019;s material and willful repudiation of his employment or of this Agreement;</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(ii) 	Executive&#x2019;s conviction of (or plea of no contest with respect to) a felony, or of a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, fraud, misappropriation or embezzlement;</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> 		(iii) 	Executive&#x2019;s demonstrable and documented fraud, misappropriation or embezzlement against the Company;</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(iv) 	Intentional, reckless or grossly negligent action which causes material harm to the Company, including any misappropriation or unauthorized use of the Company&#x2019;s property or improper use or disclosure of confidential information (but excluding any good faith exercise of business judgment); provided that Executive&#x2019;s participation in activities permitted under Section 2(b) shall not alone, constitute Cause, if Executive complies with the Company&#x2019;s applicable confidentiality, conflict of interest, and fiduciary obligations.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(v) 	Intentional failure to substantially perform material employment duties or directives (other than following resignation for Good Reason as defined below) if such failure has continued for fifteen (15) days after Executive has been notified in writing by the Company of the nature of the failure to perform (it being understood that the performance of material duties or directives is satisfied if Executive has reasonable attendance and makes good</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p></div></div><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><div style="flex-grow:1;"></div><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.4in;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:8pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:8pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:8pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;width:8.5in;page-break-after:always;">
  <div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><div style="padding-top:0.5in;z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">faith business efforts to perform his duties on behalf of the Company. The Company may not terminate Executive for Cause based solely upon the operating performance of the Company); or</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> 		(vi) 	Chronic absence from work for reasons other than illness, permitted vacation or resignation for Good Reason as defined below; or</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(vii)	Executive&#x2019;s inability to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation, the essential functions of Executive&#x2019;s position for any one hundred twenty (120) days within any continuous period of one hundred fifty (150) days by reason of physical or mental illness or incapacity; or</font></p><p style="margin-left:72pt;text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(viii)	Executive&#x2019;s death;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">provided, however, that prior to the determination that &#x201c;Cause&#x201d; under this Section 1(c) has occurred, the Company shall (A) provide to Executive in writing, in reasonable detail, the reasons for the determination that such &#x201c;Cause&#x201d; exists, (B) other than with respect to clause (vi) above which specifies the applicable period of time for Executive to remedy his or her breach, afford Executive a reasonable opportunity to remedy any such breach if subject to remedy, (C) provide Executive an opportunity to be heard prior to the final decision to terminate Executive&#x2019;s employment hereunder for such &#x201c;Cause&#x201d; and (D) make any decision that such &#x201c;Cause&#x201d; exists in good faith.</font></p><p style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The foregoing definition shall not in any way preclude or restrict the right of the Company or any successor or affiliate thereof to discharge or dismiss Executive for any other acts or omissions, but such other acts or omissions shall not be deemed, for purposes of this Agreement, to constitute grounds for termination for Cause.</font></p><p style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(d)	&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Change in Control</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; shall have the meaning given to such term in Section 2(f) of the Company&#x2019;s 2020 Stock Incentive Plan, as in effect on the date hereof; provided that in no event shall an issuance of securities by the Company for financing purposes be deemed a Change in Control for purposes of this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, to the extent required by Section 409A of the Code, if a Change in Control would give rise to a payment or benefit event with respect to any payment or benefit hereunder that constitutes &#x201c;nonqualified deferred compensation,&#x201d; the transaction or event constituting the Change in Control must also constitute a &#x201c;change in control event&#x201d; (as defined in Treasury Regulation &#167;1.409A-3(i)(5)) in order to give rise to the payment or benefit, to the extent required by Section 409A of the Code.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(e)	&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Code</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended from time to time, and the Treasury Regulations and other interpretive guidance issued thereunder.</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	(f)	&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Good Reason</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means the occurrence of any of the following events or conditions without Executive&#x2019;s written consent:</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div>
  <div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.4in;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">2</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:8pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div>
  <hr style="margin-inline-start:auto;margin-inline-end:auto;width:8.5in;page-break-after:always;">
  <div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><div style="padding-top:0.5in;z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">			(i)	The Company&#x2019;s material breach of its obligation to pay Executive the compensation earned for any past service (at the rate which had been stated to be in effect for such period of service);</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">			(ii)	a change in Executive&#x2019;s position with the Company (or successor, affiliate, parent or subsidiary of the Company employing him) which materially reduces Executive&#x2019;s duties and responsibilities as to the business conducted by the Company;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">			(iii)	a reduction in Executive&#x2019;s level of compensation (including base salary, fringe benefits (except as such reduction applies to all employees generally) and Target Bonus, (but excluding stock-based compensation) by more than fifteen percent (15%);</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">			(iv)	a material breach of this Agreement by the Company, including Section 2(b) or Schedule 1;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">			(v)	 a material and sustained requirement that Executive work more than an average of twenty-nine (29) hours per week over a consecutive sixty (60) day period, without Executive&#x2019;s written consent, excluding temporary increases reasonably necessary to address business demands; or</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">			(vi)	the failure of any successor to assume this Agreement.</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	Executive must provide written notice to the Company of the occurrence of any of the foregoing events or conditions without Executive&#x2019;s written consent within ninety (90) days of the occurrence of such event.  The Company or any successor or affiliate shall have a period of thirty (30) days to cure such event or condition after receipt of written notice of such event from Executive.  Executive&#x2019;s termination of employment by reason of resignation from employment with the Company for Good Reason shall be a &#x201c;Termination Without Cause&#x201d; only if such termination of employment occurs within thirty (30) days following the expiration of the foregoing thirty (30) day cure period. Executive&#x2019;s right to terminate employment for Good Reason shall not be affected by Executive&#x2019;s incapacity due to physical or mental illness. Executive&#x2019;s continued employment shall not constitute consent to, or a waiver of rights with respect to, any circumstance constituting Good Reason herein; provided, that the foregoing time periods shall be complied with.</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	(g)	&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Stock Awards</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means all stock options, restricted stock and such other awards granted pursuant to the Company&#x2019;s stock option and equity incentive award plans or agreements and any shares of stock issued upon exercise thereof.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	(h)	&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Termination Without Cause</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d; means (i) Executive&#x2019;s termination of employment by the Company other than for Cause, or (ii) Executive&#x2019;s resignation of employment with the Company for Good Reason.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	2.	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Services to Be Rendered.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	(a)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Duties and Responsibilities</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  Executive shall serve as Chief Business Officer of the Company (</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;CBO&#x201d;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">)</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  The CBO position is contemplated to be part-time with a 29-hour work week. Executive&#x2019;s employment hereunder has no fixed term and shall continue until</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p></div></div>
  <div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;margin-top:auto;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><div style="z-index:2;flex-direction:column;display:flex;padding-bottom:0.4in;min-height:1in;justify-content:flex-end;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:6pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:center;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">3</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:8pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div>

  <div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><div style="padding-top:0.5in;z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">terminated in accordance with Section 4. In the performance of such duties, Executive shall report directly to the Chief Executive Officer (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">CEO</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) and shall be subject to the direction of the CEO and to such limits upon Executive&#x2019;s authority as the</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">CEO may from time to time impose.  In the event of the CEO&#x2019;s incapacity or unavailability, Executive shall be subject to the direction of the Board.  Executive hereby consents to continue to serve as a general member of the Company&#x2019;s Board without any additional salary or compensation.  Executive&#x2019;s primary work arrangement shall be remote, with travel to the Company&#x2019;s Houston office and other locations, as reasonably necessary to fulfill responsibilities and as directed by the CEO.  Executive shall also render services at such other places within or outside the United States as</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">the CEO may direct from time to time.  Executive shall be subject to and comply with the policies and procedures generally applicable to employees of the Company to the extent the same are not inconsistent with any term of this Agreement.</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	(b)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Part-Time</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  Executive shall be employed by the Company on a part-time basis.  Executive shall at all times faithfully, industriously and to the best of his ability, experience and talent perform to the satisfaction of the Board and the CEO all of the duties that may be assigned to Executive hereunder and shall devote 29 hours per week of his business productive time and efforts to the performance of Executive&#x2019;s duties.  Subject to the terms of the Confidentiality and Assignment Agreement referred to in Section 5(a), this shall not preclude Executive from devoting other time to Executive&#x2019;s work for other business ventures, personal and family investments or serving on community and civic boards, or participating in industry associations, provided such activities do not interfere with his duties to the Company, or conflict with the business interests of the Company as determined in good faith by the CEO.  Executive agrees that he will not begin employment with new employers, enter into new business ventures, join any boards, other than community and civic boards (which do not interfere with his or her duties to the Company), without the prior notice and approval by the CEO, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld.  Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company acknowledges and approves Executive&#x2019;s continued service on the boards of directors and advisory boards he is currently engaged and are listed on Schedule 1 and his continued advisory and consulting work through Bethesda Group Advisors (&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">BGA</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;), including new BGA client engagements in the ordinary course of BGA&#x2019;s business (collectively, the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Existing Activities</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;). Existing Activities shall not require further approval under this Section 2(b); provided that Executive complies with Section 2(c) and the Employee Confidentiality and Assignment Agreement in conducting the Existing Activities and recuses himself from any Company matter in which an Existing Activity presents a conflict of interest.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	(c)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Other Biotechnology Activities</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  The Company acknowledges that Executive may work in other areas of the biotechnology industry, subject to Section 2(b).  However, during his employment with the Company, Executive will not serve as an employee, consultant, advisor or investor of any company that (i) develops therapies for cancers of the brain or central nervous system, or (ii) offers a product line dedicated to laboratory testing for cancers of the brain or central nervous system. Passive ownership of publicly traded stock of any similar company will not violate this Section 2(c).</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">3.	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Compensation and Benefits</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  The Company shall pay or provide, as the case may be, to Executive the compensation and other benefits and rights set forth in this Section 3.</font></p></div></div>

  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:32px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;min-width:1in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:5.625%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Base Salary</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  The Company shall pay to Executive a base salary of $344,955.00</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">per year, payable in accordance with the Company&#x2019;s usual pay practices (and in any event no less frequently than monthly). Executive&#x2019;s base salary shall be subject to review annually by and at the sole discretion of the Board or its designee.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:32px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;min-width:1in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:5.625%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Bonus</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  Executive shall participate in any bonus plan that the Board or its designee may approve for similarly situated employees of the Company.  Executive&#x2019;s target bonus under the Company&#x2019;s annual bonus plan shall be forty-three percent (43%) of Executive&#x2019;s base salary (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Target Bonus</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) and any bonus paid to the Executive shall be based upon Executive&#x2019;s performance during the year for which the bonus is being paid, in light of the corporate goals and objectives established by the compensation committee of the Board.  Except as expressly provided in this Agreement or in the terms of the annual bonus plan, and subject to Section 4(b)(ii) below, Executive&#x2019;s receipt of an annual bonus shall be conditioned on Executive&#x2019;s continued employment with the Company on the date such annual bonus is paid. Executive is ineligible for a bonus for the 2026 calendar year.</font></div></div><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	    (c) 	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Benefits</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  Based on Executive&#x2019;s anticipated part-time work schedule of 29 hours per week, Executive is not initially eligible to participate in benefits under the Company&#x2019;s benefit plans and arrangements. Should Executive subsequently become eligible for coverage, the Company will notify Executive of his eligibility and provide information regarding enrollment opportunities in accordance with the applicable benefit plans.  Eligibility will be determined in accordance with applicable law and the terms of the Company&#x2019;s benefit plans, including any applicable measurement periods.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(d)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Expenses</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  The Company shall reimburse Executive for reasonable out-of-pocket business expenses incurred in connection with the performance of his or her duties hereunder, subject to such policies as the Company may from time to time establish and Executive furnishing the Company with evidence in the form of receipts satisfactory to the Company substantiating the claimed expenditures.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:32px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;min-width:1in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:5.625%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(e)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Paid Time Off</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  Executive is eligible to accrue up to 116 hours of paid time off (&#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">PTO</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) each year as provided from time to time under the Company&#x2019;s PTO policy and as otherwise provided for similarly situated employees. PTO for the fiscal year in which Executive&#x2019;s employment begins will be prorated, based on the number of days Executive is employed by the Company during that fiscal year.  Any accrued but unused PTO will be paid out upon termination of employment, except where Executive&#x2019;s employment is terminated by the Company for Cause, to the extent permitted by applicable law. </font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:32px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;min-width:1in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:5.625%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(f)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Stock Awards</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  On the Effective Date and subject to approval by the compensation committee of the Board, the Executive will be granted a one-time equity grant as follows: an option to purchase 92,858 shares of the Company&#x2019;s common stock (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Option</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;).  The Option will have an exercise price equal to 100% of the fair market value of the Company&#x2019;s common stock at the end of business on the Effective Date.  Subject to the Executive&#x2019;s continued service through each applicable vesting date, the Option will vest in forty-eight (48) monthly installments as follows: (i) fifty percent (50%) of the shares subject to the Option will vest in twelve (12) equal monthly installments during the first twelve (12) months following the Effective Date, beginning on the one-month anniversary of the Effective Date; and (ii) the </font></div></div></div></div>

Except as otherwise provided in this Agreement, Executive&#x2019;s participation in and benefits under any such plan shall be on the terms and subject to the conditions specified in the governing document of the particular plan. The Company anticipates that, following the conclusion of Executive&#x2019;s employment, or Termination Without Cause, the Executive will continue serving as a member of the Company&#x2019;s board of directors, subject to applicable law and the Company&#x2019;s governing documents. unvested stock options, including the number of options eligible for continued vesting and the applicable vesting period, subject to the Company's equity incentive plan and applicable award agreements.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:32px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New period.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font during the period commencing on the Acquisition Agreement Date and ending on the closing of the resulting Change in Control, in addition to any accelerated vesting and/or exercisability to which Executive may be entitled pursuant to clause (i) above, the vesting and/or exercisability of any remaining outstanding unvested portions of such Stock Awards shall be automatically accelerated on the later of (A) the date of Executive&#x2019;s Termination Without Cause and (B) the date of the Change in Control.  In addition, with respect to Stock Awards granted to Executive on or after the Effective Date, such Stock Awards may be exercised by Executive (or Executive&#x2019;s legal guardian or legal representative) until the latest of (A) three (3) months after the later of the date of Executive&#x2019;s Separation from Service and the end of Executive&#x2019;s service on the Board, (B) with respect to any portion of the Stock Awards that become exercisable on the date of a Change in Control pursuant to this Section 3(g)(ii), three (3) months after the date of the Change in Control, or (C) such longer period as may be specified in this Agreement or the applicable Stock Award agreement; provided, however, that in no event shall any Stock Award remain exercisable beyond the original outside expiration date of such Stock Award.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">			(iii)	In the event of a Change in Control, the vesting and/or exercisability of any outstanding unvested portions of such Stock Awards shall be automatically accelerated on the date of such Change in Control, provided that Executive remains in the employ or service of the Company as of the closing of such Change in Control.</font></p></div></div>

The foregoing provisions are hereby deemed to be a part of each Stock Award and to supersede any less favorable provision in any agreement or plan regarding such Stock Award.</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">4.	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Severance</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  Executive shall be entitled to receive benefits upon a termination of employment only as set forth in this Section 4:</font></p><p style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(a)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">At-Will Employment; Termination</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  The Company and Executive acknowledge that Executive&#x2019;s employment is and shall continue to be at-will, as defined under applicable law, and that Executive&#x2019;s employment with the Company may be terminated by either party at any time for any or no reason, with or without notice.  If Executive&#x2019;s employment terminates for any reason, Executive shall not be entitled to any payments, benefits, damages, awards or compensation other than as provided in this Agreement.  Executive&#x2019;s employment under this Agreement shall be terminated immediately on the death of Executive. Upon a termination due to Executive&#x2019;s death or disability, Executive (or Executive&#x2019;s estate) shall receive the amounts described in clauses (i) through (iii) of Section 4(c), and Executive&#x2019;s vested Stock Awards shall remain exercisable for twelve (12) months following such termination (but not beyond the original expiration date of such Stock Award).</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><p style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(b)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Severance Upon Termination Without Cause</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.   Subject to Sections 4(d) and 9(o) and Executive&#x2019;s continued compliance with Section 5, if Executive&#x2019;s employment is Terminated Without Cause, Executive shall be entitled to receive, in lieu of any severance benefits to which Executive may otherwise be entitled under any severance plan or program of the Company, the benefits provided below:</font></p><p style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font unpaid base salary, when due, through the date of Executive&#x2019;s Termination Without Cause at the rate then in effect, all accrued but unused PTO, plus all other amounts or benefits to which Executive is entitled under any compensation, retirement or benefit plan or practice of the Company at the time of termination in accordance with the terms of such plans or practices;</font></p><p style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font equal to the sum of (A) nine (9) multiplied by Executive&#x2019;s monthly base salary as in effect immediately prior to the date of Executive&#x2019;s Termination Without Cause, plus (B) an amount equal to Executive&#x2019;s Target Bonus for the year in which Executive&#x2019;s Termination Without Cause occurs, plus (C) to the extent such Termination Without Cause occurs prior to the payment to Executive of his annual bonus for the calendar year preceding the date of such Termination Without Cause, the amount of his annual bonus for such completed calendar year;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="margin-left:4.5pt;text-indent:103.5pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(iii)	the vesting acceleration provided under Section 3(g) above; and</font></p><p style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font subject to Sections 4(d) and 9(o) and Executive&#x2019;s continued compliance with Section 5, in the event Executive&#x2019;s Termination Without Cause occurs (A) during the period commencing on the Acquisition Agreement Date and ending on the closing of the resulting Change in Control, or (B) within nine (9) months following a Change in Control, Executive shall be paid the amount as</font><font   <div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><div style="padding-top:0.5in;z-index:2;min-height:1in;position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;margin-left:0;margin-right:0;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div></div>
  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">indicated in Section 4(b)(ii) above and shall be payable in a lump sum within twenty-one (21) days following the later of (A) the effective date of Executive&#x2019;s Release and (B) the date of the Change in Control.</font></p><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(c)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Termination for Cause or Voluntary Resignation Without Good Reason</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  In the event of Executive&#x2019;s termination by the Company for Cause, or Executive&#x2019;s voluntary resignation without Good Reason, the Company shall not have any other or further obligations to Executive under this Agreement (including any financial obligations) except that Executive shall be entitled to receive (i) Executive&#x2019;s fully earned but unpaid base salary, through the date of termination at the rate then in effect, (ii) all accrued but unused PTO, and (iii) all other amounts or benefits to which Executive is entitled under any compensation, retirement or benefit plan or practice of the Company at the time of termination in accordance with the terms of such plans or practices, including, without limitation, any continuation of benefits required by applicable law.  In addition, except as provided in Section 3(f) for continued Board service following Executive&#x2019;s voluntary resignation, all vesting of Executive&#x2019;s unvested Stock Awards previously granted to him or her by the Company shall cease and none of such unvested Stock Awards shall be exercisable following the date of such termination.  The foregoing shall be in addition to, and not in lieu of, any and all other rights and remedies which may be available to the Company under the circumstances, whether at law or in equity.</font></p><p style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(d)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Release</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  As a condition to Executive&#x2019;s receipt of any post-termination benefits pursuant to Section 4(b) above, Executive shall execute and not revoke a general release of all claims in favor of the Company (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Release</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;) substantially in the form attached hereto as </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Exhibit A</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, which the Company shall deliver to Executive within seven (7) days following the date of Executive&#x2019;s termination of employment.  In the event the Release does not become effective within the thirty (30) day period following the date of Executive&#x2019;s termination of employment, Executive shall not be entitled to the aforesaid payments and benefits.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></p><h2 style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(e)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Exclusive Remedy</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  Except as otherwise expressly required by law or as specifically provided herein, all of Executive&#x2019;s rights to salary, severance, benefits, bonuses and other amounts hereunder (if any) accruing after the termination of Executive&#x2019;s employment shall cease upon such termination.  In the event of Executive&#x2019;s termination of employment with the Company, Executive&#x2019;s sole remedy shall be to receive the payments and benefits described in this Section 4.  In addition, Executive acknowledges and agrees that he or she is not entitled to any reimbursement by the Company for any taxes payable by Executive as a result of the payments and benefits received by Executive pursuant to this Section 4, including, without limitation, any excise tax imposed by Section 4999 of the Code.  If any payment or benefit to Executive would constitute a &#x201c;parachute payment&#x201d; within the meaning of Section 280G of the Code and be subject to the excise tax imposed by Section 4999 of the Code, such payments and benefits shall be either (i) delivered in full or (ii) reduced to the extent necessary so that no portion is subject to such excise tax, whichever results in Executive&#x2019;s receipt, on an after-tax basis, of the greater amount.  Any payments made to Executive under this Section 4 shall be inclusive of any amounts or benefits to which Executive may be entitled pursuant to the Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act, 29 U.S.C. Sections 2101 et seq., and the Department of Labor regulations thereunder, or any similar statute.</font></h2></div></div>

  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><div class="fixed-width-container" style="margin-left:auto;padding-left:1in;width:6.4in;box-sizing:content-box;margin-right:auto;padding-right:1.1in;"><h2 style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">		(f)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">No Mitigation</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  Executive shall not be required to mitigate the amount of any payment provided for in this Section 4 by seeking other employment or otherwise, nor shall the amount of any payment or benefit provided for in this Section 4 be reduced by any compensation earned by Executive as the result of employment by another employer or self-employment or by retirement benefits; </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">provided</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">however</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, that loans, advances or other amounts owed by Executive to the Company may be offset by the Company against amounts payable to Executive under this Section 4.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:normal;font-size:13pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </font></h2><p style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">(g)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Return of the Company&#x2019;s Property</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  In the event of Executive&#x2019;s termination of employment for any reason, the Company shall have the right, at its option, to require Executive to vacate his or her offices prior to or on the effective date of separation and to cease all activities on the Company&#x2019;s behalf.  Upon Executive&#x2019;s termination of employment in any manner, as a condition to Executive&#x2019;s receipt of any severance benefits described in this Agreement, Executive shall immediately surrender to the Company all lists, books and records of, or in connection with, the Company&#x2019;s business, and all other property belonging to the Company, it being distinctly understood that all such lists, books and records, and other documents, are the property of the Company.  Executive shall deliver to the Company a signed statement certifying compliance with this Section 4(g) prior to the receipt of any severance benefits described in this Agreement.</font></p><p style="margin-left:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">5.	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Certain Covenants</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</font></p><p style="margin-left:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:32px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:12pt;min-width:1in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:5.625%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(a)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Proprietary Information</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  Executive and the Company have entered into the Company&#x2019;s standard employee confidentiality and assignment agreement (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Employee Confidentiality and Assignment Agreement</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;).  Executive agrees to perform each and every obligation of Executive therein contained.</font></div></div><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="text-indent:72pt;tab-size:32px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:0;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;min-width:1in;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:5.625%;word-break:keep-all;text-indent:0;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">(b)</font><div style="display:inline;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Rights and Remedies Upon Breach</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.  If Executive breaches or threatens to commit a breach of any of the provisions of this Section 5 (the &#x201c;</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:italic;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Restrictive Covenants</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201d;), the Company shall have, in addition to, and not in lieu of, any other rights and remedies available to the Company under law or in equity, the right to immediately cease all payments and benefits under Section 4(b) above.</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:36pt;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:justify;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">	(c)	</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Whistleblower Provision</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">. Nothing herein shall be construed to prohibit Executive from communicating directly with, cooperating with, or providing information to, any government regulator, including, but not limited to, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission, or the U.S. Department of Justice. Executive acknowledges that the Company has provided Executive with the following notice of immunity rights in compliance with the requirements of the Defend Trade Secrets Act: (i) Executive shall not be held criminally or civilly liable under any Federal or State trade secret law for the disclosure of proprietary information of the Company that is made in confidence to a Federal, State, or local government official or to an attorney solely for the purpose of reporting or investigating a suspected violation of law, (ii) Executive shall not be held criminally or civilly liable under any Federal or State trade secret law for the disclosure of proprietary information of the Company that is made in a complaint or other document filed in a lawsuit or other proceeding, if such filing is made under seal and (iii) if Executive files a lawsuit for retaliation by the Company for reporting a suspected violation of law, Executive may disclose the proprietary</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p></div></div>
